name: rrf-lsp-vscode
description: Language support, hover documentation and more for RepRapFirmware (Duet3D) G-code files.
author: remenod

rrfgcode.activateOnGenericGcode.description: Enable LSP for generic non RRF gcode files

rrfgcode.argCheck.enabled.description: Master switch for argument validation of G/M/T commands. When false, no per-argument checks (including path existence) run.

rrfgcode.argCheck.paths.enabled.description: Warn when a string-literal path argument (e.g. M98 P"sys/foo.g") refers to a file that does not exist on the SD-card root.

rrfgcode.argCheck.paths.ignore.markdownDescription:
Glob patterns (forward slashes, relative to the SD-card root) for paths that should NOT trigger 'file not found' warnings.

Supported patterns:
- `sys/legacy.g` — exact file
- `macros/**` — entire subtree
- `macros/*.g` — direct children only
- `{old,new}/*.g` — alternation

Paths are workspace-relative on purpose, so the setting stays portable when the project is moved or shared via version control.

scripts.postinstall: cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install && cd ..
